name: Large-Scale System Design
summary: Designing internet-scale services end to end: estimation, load balancing, caching, sharding, queues and the trade-offs behind real architectures.

topics.name: Requirements, back-of-the-envelope estimation and capacity planning
Database scaling: replication, sharding and denormalization
Asynchronous processing with queues and event streams
Consistency, availability and latency trade-offs in practice
Case studies: news feeds, chat, URL shorteners and file storage
Observability, SLOs and failure handling at scale
